find_in_page_surface_label: Example browser find-in-page posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: Bounded review surface for long official voter-information pages that people may re-find through browser or app find-in-page keyword search.

reviewed_find_routes.context_posture: The matched phrase remains adjacent to the controlling heading, current election scope, and official help lane.
reviewed_find_routes.hidden_reveal_posture: The page does not rely on hidden-until-found as the only practical path to the controlling answer.

reviewed_find_routes.context_posture: An introductory summary match points directly to the full cure section instead of posing as the complete rule.
reviewed_find_routes.hidden_reveal_posture: Collapsed support text may be reviewed for search visibility, but the decisive cure steps remain reachable through ordinary visible headings and links.

first_match_integrity_note: High-stakes voter terms are reviewed so the first realistic browser-search hits land on the governing section or an honest subordinate summary rather than on misleading chrome, stale notices, or off-scope exceptions.
duplicate_match_boundary_note: Repeated navigation, banner, footer, or related-content language is reviewed so duplicated keywords do not quietly outrank the controlling official answer during manual on-page search.
hidden_until_found_boundary_note: Hidden-until-found behavior is treated as a bounded convenience and not as a blanket promise that all hidden or collapsed decisive content will become visible through browser search.
context_preservation_note: Matched phrases remain subordinate to nearby headings, freshness cues, jurisdiction scope, and help routing so browser-search highlights do not pose as standalone official rulings.
help_or_heading_refind_note: Where a keyword hit is only a summary or exception, the route keeps a clear heading path and official help lane visible enough to re-find the controlling section safely.
unsupported_or_nonreveal_recovery_note: If browser search does not reveal hidden content or lands on a secondary match first, the route still fails open through visible headings, section structure, and official help routing.
